ava.name: af_bella
ava.note: Ava - the AI agent (female, warm, clear)

caller.name: am_michael
caller.note: The caller, heard down a phone line

lines.say: Thank you for calling Northside Studio. This is Ava, an AI assistant. How can I help you today?
lines.direction: Ava, answering at 3 a.m. and still bright: warm, smiling, calm and professional; a soft, friendly lift on "How can I help you today?"

lines.say: Hi! Could I come in on Wednesday afternoon?
lines.direction: Caller (on the phone): a little tentative and hopeful, slightly hushed — it's the middle of the night; relaxed, natural.

lines.say: Of course. I have three p.m., or four thirty. Which suits you better?
lines.direction: Ava: helpful and bright; a tiny beat after "Of course."; offers the two times naturally, a light upturn on "Which suits you better?"
Caller: pleased and relieved, a small smile in the voice.

lines.say: Lovely. You're booked for Wednesday at three p.m.
lines.direction: Ava: warm, satisfied, reassuring — the payoff. A gentle smile on "Lovely."
Second caller (on the phone): curious, casual, friendly.

lines.say: I don't have an answer for that, and I don't want to guess. I'll ask the team to call you back today.
lines.direction: Ava: honest and empathetic, never robotic — a hint of apology on "I don't want to guess", then confident and kind on "I'll ask the team to call you back today."

lines.say: AI voice agents that book your customers. Twenty four seven.
lines.direction: Ava as the trailer voice-over (not on a phone): intimate, confident, cinematic, a little slower; a deliberate pause before "Twenty four seven."
Ava voice-over: calm, proud brand sign-off.
